name: 95351 · Modesto, CA
findings: ZIP 95351 (Modesto) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95351 (Modesto) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95351 (Modesto) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
